bvi.name: British Virgin Islands
bvi.description: Caribbean tax haven with high confidentiality and fast registration. British overseas territory with fiscal autonomy.

panama.name: Panama
panama.description: Corporate hub with history of media cases (Panama Papers). Global logistics center with Colón Free Zone.

switzerland.name: Switzerland
switzerland.description: Traditional private banking with greater international cooperation (AEOI/CRS). Political stability and sophisticated legal framework.

singapore.name: Singapore
singapore.description: Global financial center with moderate banking secrecy and sophisticated regulatory framework. Popular for Asian corporate structures.

uae.name: United Arab Emirates
uae.description: High financial secrecy with free zones and lax controls. Popular for trade and opaque Middle Eastern structures.

cayman.name: Cayman Islands
cayman.description: Offshore banking center with high confidentiality. Popular for investment funds and high-volume structures.

luxembourg.name: Luxembourg
luxembourg.description: European financial center known for favorable tax rulings (LuxLeaks). Popular for multinational corporate structures.

delaware.name: Delaware, United States
delaware.description: US state popular for corporate incorporation. Low cost and fast process, but less secrecy than offshore jurisdictions.

ireland.name: Ireland
ireland.description: Popular for tech companies (Double Irish). Offers knowledge boxes and aggressive transfer pricing structures.

netherlands.name: Netherlands
netherlands.description: Conduit country for tax structures (Dutch Sandwich). Withholding exemption and favorable tax treaties.

malta.name: Malta
malta.description: Small EU island state with banking secrecy and access to European markets. Popular as intermediary.

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.description: Popular destination for luxury real estate investments. London is global financial center with moderate transparency.

angola.name: Angola
angola.description: Country of origin in state corruption cases. Offshore structures used to hide public funds.

malaysia.name: Malaysia
malaysia.description: Country of origin of the 1MDB scandal. Regional financial center with moderate banking secrecy.

usa.name: United States
usa.description: Destination for high-profile investments. New York and other states offer corporate opacity similar to tax havens. Correspondent banking available for financial institutions.

jersey.name: Jersey
jersey.description: British Crown dependency with high banking confidentiality. Popular for trusts and European corporate structures.

hong-kong.name: Hong Kong
hong-kong.description: Asian global financial center with low taxation and sophisticated corporate structures. Gateway to China and Asia.

bermuda.name: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Offshore insurance center with high confidentiality. Popular for reinsurance structures and trusts.

isle-of-man.name: Isle of Man
isle-of-man.description: British Crown dependency with low taxation and banking secrecy. Popular for trusts and corporate structures.

monaco.name: Monaco
monaco.description: Principality with no personal income tax and banking secrecy. Popular for luxury assets and high-value wealth.

mauritius.name: Mauritius
mauritius.description: Gateway to Africa with favorable tax treaties. Popular for investments in the African continent and trade.

seychelles.name: Seychelles
seychelles.description: High financial secrecy with fast and low-cost corporate registration. Popular for offshore companies and opaque structures.

gibraltar.name: Gibraltar
gibraltar.description: British overseas territory with EU access. Popular for corporate structures and offshore banking.

shell-company.name: Shell Company
shell-company.description: Legal entity with no real operations used to hide ownership and origin of funds. Most common and accessible mechanism.

trust.name: Trust
trust.description: Legal structure to protect assets and hide ultimate beneficiaries. Higher security but higher costs.

nominee-director.name: Nominee Director
nominee-director.description: Straw man who signs documents on behalf of the entity to hide real control. High risk but low initial cost.

transfer-pricing.name: Transfer Pricing
transfer-pricing.description: Multinational groups set prices for intra-group transactions. By locating intellectual property in low-tax jurisdictions, royalties are charged to subsidiaries in high-tax countries.

trade-based-ml.name: Trade-Based Money Laundering
trade-based-ml.description: Manipulation of foreign trade through over/under-invoicing, multiple invoices and triangulation. Financial flows are justified through falsified customs documentation.

correspondent-banking.name: Correspondent Banking
correspondent-banking.description: Local banks maintain accounts in foreign banks to process international payments. Financial crimes exploit small banks with lax controls to access the USD/EUR system.

beneficial-ownership.name: Opaque Beneficial Ownership
beneficial-ownership.description: Legal structures that hide real ownership through layers of entities, trusts and nominee directors. Makes it difficult to trace ultimate beneficiaries.

yacht.name: Luxury Yacht
yacht.description: Increases general heat 8%. Shows off your ostentatious wealth to everyone. Makes you feel like a "winner" and money-seeking people flock to you. Easy to transport but very visible.

mansion.name: Mansion
mansion.description: Increases general heat 5%. Your symbol of success is impossible to hide. Store of value but attracts suspicious looks from tax authorities. Exclusive parties increase your "prestige".

art.name: Art Collection
art.description: Increases general heat 3%. Your "good taste" draws attention at international auctions. Easy to transport but hard to explain the origin of funds for these pieces. Art critics admire (or envy) you.

luxury_car.name: Luxury Car
luxury_car.description: Increases general heat 2%. Your luxury vehicle on the streets generates envy and suspicion. Easy to liquidate but hard to hide from authorities.

rolex.name: Rolex
rolex.description: Increases general heat 1%. Your luxury watch draws attention at social gatherings. Easy to transport and hide, but shows you have more money than you declare.

politician.name: Buy Politician
politician.description: Reduces political heat 10% in one country. Protection against investigations.

judge.name: Buy Judge
judge.description: Reduces legal heat 15%. Protection against legal proceedings.

police.name: Buy Police
police.description: Reduces legal heat 5%. Early warnings of investigations.

bank_relationship.name: Improve Bank Relationship
bank_relationship.description: Reduces fees 10% and unlocks access to premium private banking.

corporate_office.name: Offshore Corporate Office
corporate_office.description: Corporate office in offshore jurisdiction. Reduces heat 2% and generates passive income. Legitimate structure for international operations.

patent_portfolio.name: Patent Portfolio
patent_portfolio.description: Intellectual property portfolio in low-tax jurisdiction. Reduces heat 3% and allows aggressive transfer pricing. Common structure for tech multinationals.

offshore_subsidiary.name: Offshore Subsidiary
offshore_subsidiary.description: Corporate subsidiary in tax haven for tax optimization. Reduces heat 1% and allows transfer pricing structures. Base for international operations.

distribution_network.name: Distribution Network
distribution_network.description: International distribution network to facilitate trade. Enables trade-based money laundering and justifies financial flows. Common structure for multinationals.

data_center.name: Data Center
data_center.description: Data center in favorable jurisdiction. Reduces heat 1% and generates passive income. Investment in legitimate infrastructure.

multimillionaire-inheritance.title: Undeclared Inheritance
multimillionaire-inheritance.description: Your uncle, a successful businessman who operated in the real estate sector, died suddenly leaving you $5 million in cash that he kept hidden from the tax authorities for more than two decades. The money is stored in safety deposit boxes in three different countries, but you need to legitimize it quickly before tax authorities investigate the family estate.

cartel-drug-trafficking.title: Drug Trafficking
cartel-drug-trafficking.description: You are part of a drug trafficking organization that needs to launder large volumes of illicit money quickly. You have $10 million in cash that you need to legitimize before the authorities detect you.

cartel-cryptocurrency.title: Cryptocurrency and Trafficking
cartel-cryptocurrency.description: Your organization has accumulated $15 million in cryptocurrencies through trafficking operations. You need to convert these cryptocurrencies into clean money without attracting attention.

multinational-tax-optimization.title: Multinational Tax Optimization
multinational-tax-optimization.description: You are a multinational corporation that needs to optimize its global tax structure. You have $50 million in profits that you need to protect from taxes through legal but aggressive structures.

multinational-real-estate.title: Multinational Real Estate Investment
multinational-real-estate.description: Your corporation invests in luxury real estate in multiple jurisdictions. You need to structure these investments to minimize taxes and maximize opacity.

multimillionaire-art.title: Art and Wealth
multimillionaire-art.description: You are a multimillionaire who has accumulated an art collection worth millions. You need to structure this collection to protect it from taxes and hide its true value.

panama-papers.name: Panama Papers
panama-papers.summary: Massive leak of Mossack Fonseca documents that exposed offshore structures of politicians, celebrities and businessmen from around the world.

1mdb.name: 1MDB Scandal
1mdb.summary: Corruption scandal in Malaysia where $4.5 billion was diverted from a state investment fund.

jho-low-1mdb.name: The 1MDB Scheme
jho-low-1mdb.summary: Jho Low orchestrated one of the largest money laundering scandals, embezzling $4.5 billion from Malaysia's 1MDB sovereign fund.

isabel-dos-santos.name: Luanda Leaks
isabel-dos-santos.summary: Isabel dos Santos, daughter of Angola's former president, accumulated $2+ billion through state contracts and offshore structures.

hsbc-drug-money.name: HSBC Scandal: Drug Money Laundering
hsbc-drug-money.summary: HSBC facilitated the laundering of at least $881 million in drug trafficking proceeds for Mexican cartels, processing billions more through its US subsidiary.

hsbc-swiss-leaks.name: Swiss Leaks: HSBC's Secret Bank
hsbc-swiss-leaks.summary: HSBC Switzerland helped over 100,000 clients evade taxes and hide assets, with over $100 billion in accounts.

danske-bank-estonia.name: Danske Bank Money Laundering Scandal
danske-bank-estonia.summary: Danske Bank's Estonia branch processed $230 billion in suspicious transactions, primarily from Russian and former Soviet clients.

pandora-papers.name: Pandora Papers: The Massive Leak
pandora-papers.summary: Pandora Papers exposed the offshore operations of more than 330 politicians and high-level officials from 90+ countries, revealing how they used tax havens to hide wealth.

ricardo-martinelli.name: Ricardo Martinelli: The New Business Case
ricardo-martinelli.summary: Former Panamanian president Ricardo Martinelli was convicted of money laundering in the "New Business" case, related to purchasing a media conglomerate using illicit funds.

alejandro-toledo.name: Alejandro Toledo: Odebrecht Bribes
alejandro-toledo.summary: Former Peruvian president Alejandro Toledo was sentenced to 13 years and 4 months in prison for receiving $35 million in bribes from Odebrecht to favor the company in public works contracts.

jordi-pujol.name: Jordi Pujol: Catalonia's Hidden Fortune
jordi-pujol.summary: Former president of Catalonia's Generalitat, Jordi Pujol, and his family were investigated for hiding a fortune of over $300 million in foreign accounts without declaring them to Spanish tax authorities.

lava-jato.name: Operation Lava Jato
lava-jato.summary: Massive corruption investigation in Brazil that exposed bribery and money laundering schemes throughout Latin America.

panama.name: Panama Papers (Individual Case)
panama.summary: Individual case based on the Panama Papers where a multimillionaire used offshore structures to hide wealth.

bvi.name: BVI Structures
bvi.summary: Use of structures in the British Virgin Islands to hide ownership and origin of funds.

switzerland.name: Swiss Private Banking
switzerland.summary: Use of Swiss private banking to hide funds and avoid taxes.

apple-tax-structure.name: Apple Tax Structure
apple-tax-structure.summary: Aggressive tax optimization by Apple using transfer pricing and structures in Ireland and other countries.

wirecard-scandal.name: Wirecard Scandal
wirecard-scandal.summary: Massive fraud at German fintech company Wirecard involving offshore structures and money laundering.

odebrecht-scandal.name: Odebrecht Scandal
odebrecht-scandal.summary: Massive bribery scheme by Brazilian construction company Odebrecht in multiple Latin American countries.

fifa-corruption.name: FIFA Corruption
fifa-corruption.summary: Corruption scheme in FIFA involving bribes, money laundering and offshore structures.

russian-oligarchs.name: Russian Oligarchs
russian-oligarchs.summary: Use of offshore structures by Russian oligarchs to hide wealth and avoid sanctions.

crypto-exchange.name: Cryptocurrency Exchange
crypto-exchange.summary: Use of cryptocurrency exchanges and offshore structures to launder illicit money.

luxury-real-estate.name: Luxury Real Estate
luxury-real-estate.summary: Use of luxury real estate in London, New York and other financial centers to hide wealth.

welcome.title: Welcome to the Tutorial
welcome.description: This educational game will teach you how tax havens and money laundering work. You will learn by interacting with the interface. Let's begin.

selectCountry.title: Select a Country
selectCountry.description: First, you need to choose a tax haven where you will establish your structures. Click on the "Select Country" button on the left and then choose a country in the dialog (for example, BVI).

nextAfterCountry.title: Continue to Next Step
nextAfterCountry.description: Perfect! You have selected a country. Now click on the "Next" button to continue.

selectMechanism.title: Select a Mechanism
selectMechanism.description: Now you need to choose how you will launder money. Click on the "Select Mechanism" button to see the available options. In the tutorial, you will see "Shell Company" and "Trust". Select one (for example, Shell Company).

nextAfterMechanism.title: Continue to Next Step
nextAfterMechanism.description: Excellent! You have selected a mechanism. Click on the "Next" button to continue.

executeTransaction.title: Execute Your First Transaction
executeTransaction.description: With a country and mechanism selected, you can now execute a transaction. In the transaction panel, enter an amount (for example, $500,000) and click "Execute Transaction".

nextAfterTransaction.title: Continue to Next Step
nextAfterTransaction.description: Well done! You have executed your first transaction. Click on the "Next" button to continue.

viewDashboard.title: Monitor Your Progress
viewDashboard.description: The Dashboard on the right shows your progress. You will see your funds, laundered money, and "Heat" (risk). Watch the Heat - if it reaches 100%, you lose.

purchaseAsset.title: Purchase an Asset
purchaseAsset.description: With clean money, you can purchase assets. Go to the "Purchase Assets" tab in the Dashboard. In the tutorial, you can purchase a Luxury Car or a Rolex. Click "Purchase" on one of them.

complete.title: Tutorial Completed!
complete.description: You have learned the basics. You can continue playing freely. Remember: this game is based on real cases from journalistic investigations about tax havens.
